representative_text: I have a patient with a large vulvar tumor (6cm) requiring interstitial HDR brachytherapy. The template has 16 needles in a modified Heyman pattern. The prescription dose is 3 Gy per fraction in 12 fractions. Optimize to achieve adequate coverage of the large treatment volume while respecting the tolerance of the urethra (D2cc < 65 Gy EQD2) and anus (D2cc < 60 Gy EQD2).
